environment: Disposable restored local database with migrations 127-134 and source-equivalent application ACL only on the clone. Actual candidate Next page and Skill/memory/schedule APIs with one synthetic account. Clone dropped after verification.

results.actualPage: At 390x760 and 1366x900, the settings page opened all three management sections. A one-shot HTTP 503 was injected only for memory GET on refresh; Skill and schedule sections remained ready, the memory pane displayed a read error rather than an empty conclusion, and unsaved Skill/schedule form drafts remained. A later real API refresh cleared the memory error.
results.actualSkillWrites: Each viewport saved one instruction-only Skill through the actual POST API. Database readback found exactly two account-scope, enabled=false drafts with the expected names. The UI described them as unenabled drafts. The schedule draft was never submitted; the database contained zero schedules for the synthetic account.
results.failureInjection: Memory 503 was intercepted at the response boundary for one request; it does not establish a natural production service failure.

limits: The test used a synthetic account and one response-boundary failure. It does not prove natural memory quality, Skill activation eligibility, schedule execution, production loading, or all G13 entries.
